group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-09-14, corresponding author: 'Aldaz CM[au]' 138, 'Aldaz CM[au] AND WWOX' 38. First author 'Hussain T[au] AND WWOX' 6. Model provider 'Chesi M[au]' 122, of which 'Chesi M[au] AND WWOX' 1 - this paper. 'Abba MC[au] AND WWOX' 10.
group_assessment.weighting: Three capabilities, weighed apart, and the split is the reason to trust different halves differently. The Aldaz laboratory is primary for the gene (38 of 138 papers) AND is one of the few groups that works on WWOX neurological disease - its own refs 32 and 33 are the hippocampal-interneuron and P47T epilepsy papers - so both flags are true, while this output touches neither the disease nor a disease allele. The myeloma model is NOT this laboratory's: Vk*MYC is Chesi's, supplied as a collaboration (122 papers, 1 on WWOX), and she declares royalties from licensing those mice, so the model half carries both genuine expertise and a declared financial interest. The genomics half (RNA-seq, WES, signatures, CNV) is Abba's and Bramble's established method work. Net: the per-sample sequencing observations weigh as competent primary work; the inflammation conclusion weighs as Ingenuity pathway inference with no protein measurement; and the words 'promotes' and 'key driver' weigh as the group's interpretation of a marginal incidence difference.

field_density.note: WWOX x myeloma is 15 papers in all of PubMed and WWOX x B-cell 14, against 708 for WWOX overall, so this is a thin field in which one laboratory holds most of the in-vivo work. The intersection that matters for strength is narrower still: crossing Vk*MYC (63 papers) with WWOX returns this paper alone, so the Wwox-plus-MYC observation has no independent replication.

entries.proposition: THE DEPOSITED EXPRESSION WORKBOOK QUALIFIES THE INFLAMMATION SIGNATURE, and this is visible nowhere else. Of the 87 differentially expressed genes, 31 are immunoglobulin V-region genes, and 19 of the 20 largest effects by absolute fold change are immunoglobulin genes running in BOTH directions (Ighv5-9 +10.60, Igkv8-18 +8.64 against Igkv5-45 -7.60, Ighv14-4 -7.42) - the pattern expected from different clonal populations between animals rather than from a regulatory programme. The four genes the text names are modest and mid-list: Foxq1 +1.64 (rank 28), Vegfa +1.54 (30), Jun +1.44 (34), Tgfb2 +1.05 (46). The same sheet also shows Wwox itself down only 1.61 log2, adjusted p 0.021, in the sorted knockout cells.

entries.proposition: THE DEPOSITED SEGMENT TABLE QUALIFIES 'EXTENSIVE' IN TWO WAYS. The four tumours carry 17, 59, 44 and 7 copy-number segments, so Figure 7B's caption phrase 'widespread and pronounced copy number alterations across all samples' does not hold for KO4-PBT, whose own panel is essentially flat. And the chr11 interval containing Rel, Xpo1 and Bcl11a - reported only as an amplicon - is a GAIN in KO1-PBT (copy number 4) and KO4-PBT (3) but a LOSS in KO2-PBT (copy number 1), a direction the text does not mention.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 6, PIXELS - THE PAPER CONTRADICTS ITSELF ABOUT WHICH TUMOUR IS WHICH, and the Aicda/Apobec2 claim hangs on the answer. Figure 6A's column headers and Figure 6B's panel titles both label KO1-PBT as the PBL and KO4-PBT as a PBP; Figure 6C's caption states the opposite, calling the green point 'KO1-PBT (PBP)' and the red point 'KO4-PBT (PBL)'. Nothing in the artefact adjudicates, so the sample identity behind the deaminase result is unresolved.
